Coram : D.Y. CHANDRACHUD*, M.R. SHAH
Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 – ss. 10, 31, 60(5), 61, 238 – Power Purchase Agreement – Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process – Jurisdiction of NCLT over contractual dispute – The appellant allocated a 25-megawatt capacity to the Corporate Debtor for project – The appellant and the corporate debtor entered into a PPA on 30.04.2010, according to which the appellant was to purchase all the power generated by the corporate debtor – Due to floods and heavy rainfall in 2015 then again in 2017, Plant was severely damaged –
Decision Date : 08-03-2021 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 9241/2019 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
